What We Believe

We BelieveThe Bible is the inspired Word of God which was given to us for instruction, correction and inspiration.In one God manifested in the Persons of the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit.Man was created in the image of God, and because of man’s disobedience in the garden we are all born with a sin nature.Jesus Christ is the Son of God, was conceived by the Holy Spirit through the Virgin Mary, and born to deliver us from our fallen sin nature.Jesus died on the Cross, rose from the dead, and is alive today, and as a result, eternal life is ours, as we believe and confess Jesus as Savior
